text: A bright category card puzzle set in Egypt.

captions.instagram:
Meet Kinfold, our first game.
Look at the cards, drop each one into its group, clear the board. Every card shows something from Egypt.
Coming to iOS and Android. Play in English or Arabic.

دي Kinfold، أول لعبة لينا
بص على الكروت، حط كل كارت في مجموعته، وفضّي اللوحة. كل كارت فيه حاجة من مصر.
جاية على iOS و Android، بالعربي والإنجليزي.

Our first game has a name: Kinfold.

It's a category card puzzle set in Egypt. Every card shows something from Egypt, and you sort them into their groups to clear the board. Quick levels made for short breaks, in English or Arabic.

Coming to iOS and Android. More soon.
